description: Implement a scoped code change with hash-checked edits and passing registered tests.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: patch
outputs.description: The applied edits with before and after hashes.

outputs.name: testReceipt
outputs.description: The passing test.run receipt for the final revision.

steps.description: Read every file you will edit and keep the hash file.read returns; each edit must name the hash it was based on.
Edit only owned paths. Prefer exact replacements over rewriting whole files, and keep unrelated behavior intact.
steps.evidence: A file.apply_patch receipt listing before and after hashes.

steps.description: Run the registered tests. If they fail, read the failure, fix the cause, and run them again.
steps.evidence: A passing test.run receipt bound to the current revision.

steps.description: Summarize what changed and why, citing the patch and test receipts.
steps.evidence: A summary that cites receipts only.
